# hyperlite_storage_pool (Resource)

A storage pool of the node the provider talks to: a directory, an NFS export, a ZFS pool or an iSCSI target. Its name changes in place; anything else replaces it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hyperlite_storage_pool" "fast" {
  name = "fast"
  type = "dir"
  path = "/srv/fast"
}

resource "hyperlite_storage_pool" "nas" {
  name            = "nas"
  type            = "netfs"
  nfs_host        = "nas.example.internal"
  nfs_export_path = "/export/vms"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Its name. A change renames it.
- `type` (String) `dir` (a directory of the node), `netfs` (an NFS export, shared storage), `zfs` or `iscsi`.

### Optional

- `chap_password` (String, Sensitive) For `iscsi`: the CHAP password (never read back).
- `chap_user` (String) For `iscsi`: the CHAP user.
- `iscsi_host` (String) For `iscsi`: the target's address.
- `iscsi_target` (String) For `iscsi`: the target's IQN.
- `nfs_export_path` (String) For `netfs`: the export.
- `nfs_host` (String) For `netfs`: the NFS server.
- `nfs_version` (String) For `netfs`: the NFS version (`4.2` when absent).
- `node` (String) The member of the cluster the storage pool is on (absent: the node the provider talks to). Another member makes it again there.
- `path` (String) For `dir`: the directory.
- `size_gb` (Number) For `zfs`: the size of the pool's backing file.

### Read-Only

- `capacity_gb` (Number) Its capacity, in GB.
- `id` (String) The pool's name.
- `state` (String) `active`, `inactive`, `building`, `degraded` or `inaccessible`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By the pool's name; the same led by `<node>/` for one on another node of the cluster.
terraform import hyperlite_storage_pool.fast fast
terraform import hyperlite_storage_pool.fast pve-b/fast
```
